memory_candidates.content: When a README's opening-lines budget has zero slack (a protected generated-content block plus fixed badges consuming the whole span), fold pre-existing bold-label link lines (e.g. '**Main Results**:', '**Demo**:') into the closing sentences of a new summary paragraph rather than presenting the summary as a bulleted list. A dense single-line paragraph costs 3 physical source lines (blank + text + blank) against the budget, versus 7-8 for an equivalent 4-6 bullet list with a lead-in line — the difference between landing comfortably under the limit and landing exactly at it.
